editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the ACCA Finance and Investment exam by mastering investment appraisal, working capital, business valuations, and risk management.
editorial.overview: The ACCA Finance and Investment certification assesses professional knowledge in corporate finance, investment appraisal, working capital management, business valuations, and risk management. Certified by ACCA, the computer-based examination requires candidates to apply technical skills to evaluate financial and investment strategies effectively over the course of 180 minutes to achieve a passing score.
editorial.who_should_take: This certification suits accounting professionals, finance candidates, and practitioners seeking to validate their expertise in investment decision-making, working capital strategies, business valuations, and risk management techniques.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review the official syllabus and study guide carefully to prepare for the assessment. Practice calculating the weighted average cost of capital, applying discounted cash flow methods, and analyzing working capital strategies. Review technical articles and tackle scenario-based questions across all domains to ensure complete readiness.

domain_guidance.summary: This specific domain covers the finance and investment environment, focusing heavily on strategic objectives, economic policies, financial markets, and institutional frameworks that govern modern corporate financial decisions across various global markets.

This domain focuses on working capital management, examining inventory management, accounts receivable, accounts payable, cash management, and overall funding strategies to ensure proper liquidity and operational efficiency within organizations.
study_focus: Nature, elements and importance of working capital
Management of inventories, accounts receivable, accounts payable and cash
Working capital needs and funding strategies

domain_guidance.summary: This section explores investment appraisal techniques, incorporating inflation, taxation, risk, uncertainty, and specific investment decisions to help financial professionals evaluate capital expenditure projects accurately and make sound corporate choices.
study_focus: Risk and uncertainty in investment appraisal

domain_guidance.summary: This domain examines business finance deeply, covering diverse sources of finance, the cost of capital, relative costs, and complex capital structure theories that guide long-term corporate funding and financial planning.
study_focus: Capital structure theories and practical considerations

domain_guidance.summary: This section details business valuations by addressing equity valuations, debt valuations, financial asset assessments, and efficient market hypotheses to equip candidates with methods for determining accurate asset worth.
study_focus: Nature and purpose of the valuation of business and financial assets
Valuation of debt and other financial assets

domain_guidance.summary: This domain focuses intensely on risk management, analyzing foreign currency risk, interest rate fluctuations, and distinct hedging techniques to protect corporate assets against unexpected financial volatility and market movements.
study_focus: Exchange rate differences and interest rate fluctuations
Hedging techniques for foreign currency risk
Hedging techniques for interest rate risk

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Manage your 180-minute exam time effectively across all sections. Section A contains objective test questions, Section B includes case questions, and Section C features constructed response questions.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The examination consists of multiple sections containing numerous question types, including objective test questions in Section A, case questions in Section B, and constructed response questions in Section C.
The passing score required for this professional examination is set at 50 percent, which candidates must achieve to successfully demonstrate their required competencies and knowledge.
The computer-based examination has a total duration of 180 minutes, providing candidates with ample time to complete all of the required sections successfully during the testing session.

faq.question_title: What is the certification path after this exam?
faq.answer_text: For specific information regarding the long-term certification path and current details, you should check directly with ACCA for official guidance and updates regarding your career progression.

methodology.summary: This detailed page was constructed using official ACCA syllabus documentation, study guides, and relevant technical articles for the finance and investment examination.
